name: clipboard
title: Clipboard
description: What you copied, searchable, with images; pinned entries first, a filter by kind (text, images, files, links, colors). Enter pastes it back into the app in front; an entry can be edited, named, saved as a file or a snippet, or shown as a QR code.
author: pal

settings.label: Exclude apps
settings.description: Bundle ids (com.1password.1password) or names; copies made in these are not recorded, and none already recorded is listed.

settings.label: Keep entries
settings.description: How many unpinned entries history keeps; older ones past this are deleted on the next copy.

settings.label: Keep for
settings.description: Unpinned entries older than this are deleted on the next copy. 0 keeps them until the entry limit.

settings.label: OCR copies are private
settings.text: Text read from an image (Copy text from image) is kept out of this history

settings.label: Primary action
settings.description: What Enter does on an entry.

options.title: Paste into the app in front

store.tagline: Everything you copied, with images; Enter pastes it back
features: Text, images and file lists, recorded while pal runs, searched with SQLite full-text search on every keystroke
The detail pane open from the start: the full text, the image, or the file list, with kind, size, source app and time
Pinned entries in a section at the top, never expiring; the rest newest first, kept for `max_age_days` and `max_entries`
Filters: All, Text, Images, Files, Links (text that is one url) and Colors (a `#hex` or `rgb()`, drawn as a swatch)

Paste (`enter`) or copy back (`cmd+enter`), paste as plain text (`cmd+shift+v`), open a link (`cmd+o`), copy an image as a file (`cmd+shift+c`), copy the text in an image (`cmd+shift+t`, OCR: the Vision framework on macOS, `tesseract` on Linux)

Edit a text entry (`cmd+e`, the edited text copied as the newest entry), name one (`cmd+shift+r`: the row's title, found by search), save it as a file (`cmd+s`), as a snippet (`cmd+shift+s`), or show it as a QR code (`cmd+shift+k`)
Never recorded: what a password manager marks concealed (pal's own concealed copies too: a 1Password password, a verification code), copies over 10 MB, copies made in an excluded app

screenshots.caption: The history with the pane open: pinned first (a named entry by its name), then newest, the source app and the time on the right
An image entry: its size and dimensions, the picture in the pane
The Colors filter: a copied colour is its own swatch on the row and in the pane
Paste, Copy, Open link, Edit, Pin, Name, Save as file, Save as snippet, Show as QR code, Delete, Clear history
Edit (cmd+E): the text in a textarea; the submit copies it, so the edited text is the newest entry
Show as QR code (cmd+shift+K): the entry's text as a code to scan, large in a level

actions.title: Paste
actions.description: Hides the panel and pastes the entry into the app that was in front.

actions.title: Copy
actions.description: Puts the entry back on the clipboard.

actions.title: Open link
actions.description: On an entry that is one url.

actions.title: Copy image file
actions.description: The PNG the recorder keeps, as a file.

actions.title: Copy text from image
actions.description: OCR over the image (Vision on macOS, tesseract on Linux); the text goes on the clipboard.

actions.title: Edit…
actions.description: On a text entry: a textarea with the text; the submit copies the edited text (a box pastes it too), so it is the newest entry.

actions.title: Pin / Unpin
actions.description: Pinned entries sort first and never expire.

actions.title: Name… / Rename…
actions.description: A name that titles the row and is searched like the text; empty clears it.

actions.title: Save as file…
actions.description: A folder (the Desktop) and a name from the entry: the text, the image's PNG, or the file list as paths. An existing name is refused.

actions.title: Save as snippet
actions.description: On a text entry: the Snippets form, pre-filled.

actions.title: Show as QR code
actions.description: On a text entry up to 2000 characters: the code large in a level.

copy.description: Put a history entry back on the clipboard

index.description: Which entry, newest first: 0 is the newest (the default)

rows.title: Clipboard
rows.description: What is on the clipboard now, as the things it could be: a web address (open, private window, markdown link, QR code), a colour (the picker, every notation), paths (open, reveal, open with), an email, a phone number, JSON (pretty, minified), an expression or a number (the answer, other bases), a timestamp or ISO date (local and relative), hex or base64 that decodes to text, a tracking number (the carrier), a git sha or owner/repo#12 (GitHub), an image (save, copy as file, OCR), and the text itself (counts, case and slug transforms, paste as plain, save as snippet). The root's Clipboard section before you type; Hide keeps it away until the next copy. Only what history recorded is read: a concealed copy or one from an excluded app never shows.

settings.label: Fetch page titles
settings.text: Ask a copied web address for its title (one request, 1 s at most; the only thing these rows send off the machine)

settings.label: URL shortener
settings.description: A URL with {url} in it whose response body is the short link, for the Shorten action (https://is.gd/create.php?format=simple&url={url}). Empty: no Shorten action.

settings.label: Private window browser
settings.description: Which browser opens a private window: Google Chrome, Brave Browser, Microsoft Edge, Chromium, Vivaldi or Firefox. Empty: the first of those that is installed.
